offering_description.value: Provides engineering, technology and operations services that support government missions in defense, intelligence, space, energy and environmental cleanup. Serves mainly US federal agencies and allied governments through long-term contracts, delivered by its own staff and subcontractors.

primary_services.value: engineering and technical services; mission operations and logistics; facility operations and maintenance; environmental remediation; cybersecurity and IT services

customer_segment.value: B2G: US federal agencies such as defense, intelligence, space and energy departments, UK and Australian government customers

end_markets.value: defense; intelligence; space; energy and nuclear; environmental remediation

revenue_model.value: project or contract: cost-reimbursable and fixed-price government contracts for engineering and operations work; service fees: fees for technical, logistics and facility management services

value_chain_position.value: service provider: delivers engineering, operations and mission support, sold to government agencies

geography_served.value: global: US federal work as the main market, also UK, Australia and other allied countries

specialization.value: related lines: engineering, technical and operations services, energy and environmental support, and IT for government customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct bids and contract awards from government agencies; partners / resellers: joint ventures and teaming arrangements with other contractors

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: federal procurement, security clearance and export control rules such as FAR, DFARS and ITAR

notes: Business mix is based on general knowledge and may have changed since the 2024 corporate restructuring.
